  SELECT id, set_num FROM (
    SELECT id, set_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) rn
    FROM inventories
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
explode AS (
  -- parts directly in the set's current inventory
  SELECT ip.part_num, ip.quantity AS qty
  FROM current_inv ci
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
  WHERE ci.set_num = '80033-1' AND ip.is_spare = false
  UNION ALL
  -- nested sets
  SELECT e.part_num, e.qty * ins.quantity
  FROM explode e
  JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.part_num
  JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.id = ins.inventory_id

  -- minifigs
  SELECT e.part_num, e.qty * im.quantity
  FROM explode e
  JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = e.part_num
  JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.id = im.inventory_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM explode
WHERE part_num = '15504';

  SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Juniors'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN juniors j ON t.parent_id = j.id
),
sets_2016 AS (
  SELECT s.set_num
  FROM sets s
  WHERE s.year = 2016 AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM juniors)
),
current_edges AS (
  SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, child_kind, child_num, color_id, qty, is_spare
  FROM u_composition u
  WHERE version = (
    SELECT MAX(version) FROM u_composition u2
    WHERE u2.parent_kind = u.parent_kind AND u2.parent_num = u.parent_num
  )
),
explode AS (
  SELECT s.set_num AS root_set, e.child_kind, e.child_num, e.color_id, e.qty AS qty, e.is_spare
  FROM sets_2016 s
  JOIN current_edges e ON e.parent_kind = 'set' AND e.parent_num = s.set_num
  UNION ALL
  SELECT x.root_set, e.child_kind, e.child_num, e.color_id, x.qty * e.qty, e.is_spare
  FROM explode x
  JOIN current_edges e ON e.parent_kind = x.child_kind AND e.parent_num = x.child_num
  WHERE x.child_kind IN ('set','minifig')
),
part_counts AS (
  SELECT root_set, SUM(qty) AS parts
  FROM explode
  WHERE child_kind = 'part' AND is_spare = FALSE
  GROUP BY root_set
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pc.parts, 0)), 2) AS avg_parts
FROM sets_2016 s
LEFT JOIN part_counts pc ON pc.root_set = s.set_num;

WITH RECURSIVE
root AS (
  SELECT '66638-1'::VARCHAR AS set_num
),
-- recursive expansion of set 66638-1 using inventory version 1 for the root,
-- and current inventories for nested sets/minifigs
explode AS (
  -- direct children of the root from version 1
  SELECT
    c.child_kind,
    c.child_num,
    c.qty::BIGINT AS qty
  FROM u_composition c
  JOIN root r ON c.parent_kind = 'set' AND c.parent_num = r.set_num
  WHERE c.version = 1

  UNION ALL

  -- expand nested sets and minifigs using their current inventory
  SELECT
    c.child_kind,
    c.child_num,
    e.qty * c.qty::BIGINT AS qty
  FROM explode e
  JOIN u_composition c
    ON c.parent_kind = e.child_kind
   AND c.parent_num = e.child_num
   AND c.version = (
        SELECT MAX(c2.version)
        FROM u_composition c2
        WHERE c2.parent_kind = c.parent_kind
          AND c2.parent_num = c.parent_num
   )
  WHERE e.child_kind IN ('set','minifig')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_minifig_count
FROM explode
WHERE child_kind = 'minifig';
